stem:
Anaya grows a bean seedling. She places it so sunlight comes only from the left side.

What should she expect?

options.text: The shoot bends toward the left and the root grows downward.
The root bends toward the left and the shoot grows straight upward.
The shoot bends toward the right and the root grows downward.
The shoot grows straight upward and the root grows downward, with no bend toward the light.

teacher.key_rationale: Shoots grow toward sunlight, so with light from the left the shoot bends left; roots grow downward. Giving the bend to the root, bending the shoot away from the light, or denying any bend toward light are wrong.
